{{Top|leg}}
The gas '''carbon monoxide (CO)''' was a molecule composed of one [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] atom and one [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] atom. It was poisonous to inhale for some [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], ex-[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] ran a gas line of carbon monoxide into her [[Water/Legends|water]] tank to commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]].
